title: LLM serving throughput vs TTFT SLA frontier
what: Batch size 16 is the max SLA-compliant operating point: 748 tok/s at 168 ms p95 TTFT (batch 32 breaches 200 ms at 294 ms)

reader_questions.question: What is the maximum throughput achievable while meeting the 200 ms TTFT SLA?
reader_questions.expected: About 748 tok/s at batch size 16 (p95 TTFT = 168 ms).

reader_questions.question: What happens if batch size is increased to 32?
reader_questions.expected: Throughput rises slightly to 1,039 tok/s, but p95 TTFT jumps to 294 ms, breaching the 200 ms SLA.

reader_questions.question: How does inter-token latency behave at batch 16 vs 64?
reader_questions.expected: ITL rises from 21.4 ms at batch 16 to 49.5 ms at batch 64.
